_comment: Strings the app needs that the design prototype did not include: error copy, auth failures, generic actions, and the sign-in/sign-up screens. The design goes splash -> welcome -> onboarding with no auth forms, so that copy is written here. Design-derived strings live in design/extracted/strings.json and are never edited by hand.
